stories.title: What we know about the attack on a synagogue in Michigan
stories.summary: A man drove a truck into a synagogue in Michigan, according to authorities. The suspected attacker is dead and a guard was injured.

stories.title: Trump's peace plan for Gaza stalls as Iran war grinds on
stories.summary: Gains made in Gaza ceasefire slide as Trump's attention turns to Iran war and Israel tightens its siege

stories.title: Despite Trump's frustration, Spain's Pedro Sánchez doubles down on opposing the war
stories.summary: President Trump has been voicing his frustration with the Spanish government's opposition to the war in Iran. But far from backing down, Spain's prime minister is happy to walk into the spotlight.

stories.title: After firings, funding cuts and a shooting, can a demoralized CDC workforce recover?
stories.summary: It's been a year since mass firings began at the CDC, the federal public health agency. Then came a shooting, and the government shutdown. Atlanta is still feeling the economic and emotional effects.

stories.title: Paralympics star Oksana Masters shares her experience with this year's Games
stories.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Paralympic athlete Oksana Masters about her experiences at this year's Games in Italy.

stories.title: Comedian Chris Fleming loves Terry Gross
stories.summary: In the new HBO special from Chris Fleming, the comedian spends a lot of time talking about Terry Gross. Wild Card host Rachel Martin talks to Fleming about what he loves about the Fresh Air host.
